grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Our Things
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage: My name is Li Ming. I am a student. This is my family. We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me. We are in Beijing. My father is a teacher. My mother is a nurse. My sister is a student, too. We have a small dog. His name is Lucky. Lucky has a red ball. My sister and I have two bikes. They are blue. My mother has a new phone. Her phone is white. My father has a big book. His book is on the desk. We are happy.

questions.explanation: 原文说“We are four people”，意思是“我们是四口人”。
questions.evidence: We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.

questions.prompt: 李明的爸爸是做什么工作的？
questions.explanation: 原文说“My father is a teacher.”，所以爸爸是老师。

questions.prompt: 李明的妈妈是做什么工作的？
questions.explanation: 原文说“My mother is a nurse.”，所以妈妈是护士。
原文说“My sister and I have two bikes.”，意思是“我和妹妹有两辆自行车”。
questions.evidence: My sister and I have two bikes.

questions.explanation: 原文说“His name is Lucky.”，这里的His指狗，所以狗的名字是Lucky。

questions.prompt: 李明的妈妈有一个新手机。她的手机是什么颜色的？请用原文中的一个词填空：______
questions.explanation: 原文说“Her phone is white.”，所以手机是白色的。

questions.prompt: 李明的爸爸有一本大书。这本书在哪里？请用原文中的两个词填空：on the ______
questions.explanation: 原文说“His book is on the desk.”，所以书在桌子上。
questions.evidence: His book is on the desk.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，他们感觉怎么样？
questions.explanation: 原文最后一句说“We are happy.”，意思是“我们很开心”。

vocabulary.example: My mother has a new phone.
His book is on the desk.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：have/has 与形容词性物主代词
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，表示“有”用 have 或 has。I、you、we、they 用 have；he、she、it 用 has。表示“我的、你的、他的、她的”等，用 my、your、his、her 等词，后面直接加名词。
grammar.example: My sister and I have two bikes. My mother has a new phone. Her phone is white.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：I ______ a red pen.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，所以用 have。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：She ______ a small cat.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，所以用 has。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：This is my brother. ______ name is Tom.
questions.explanation: brother 是男性，所以用 His。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：My mother has a bag. ______ bag is black.
questions.explanation: mother 是女性，所以用 Her。

part1: How many people are there in your family?
speaking.part2: Describe your family. You should say:
part3: How many people are there in your family?
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
What do you and your family do together?

transfer.writing: 写一段话介绍你的家庭，至少5句话。用上 have/has 和 my/your/his/her。
